name: Send a weekly social analytics digest for every brand to Slack with Socialync

parameters.content:
### How it works
Every Monday this workflow lists your Socialync profiles, reads last week's numbers for each one, and sends one Slack message that covers all of them. Each brand shows views, likes, comments, shares, followers and the change from the week before, with the platforms that earned the most views. This helps agencies and anyone who runs more than one brand. The workflow only reads. It cannot post or change anything in Socialync.

### Setup
1. Create an API key at https://socialync.io/go/n8n-node-keys and add it as a Socialync credential.
2. Add a Slack credential.
3. In Settings, enter your Slack channel ID.
4. Run the workflow once by hand to see the first digest.

### Customization
Change the day and time in the trigger node. Set period to month in Settings for a monthly digest. YouTube numbers are shown as YouTube reports them, without extra math. A brand that returns no data appears in the message with the reason.

API reference: https://socialync.io/go/n8n-node

nodes.name: Read the numbers for each profile

parameters.content:
## Read your numbers
Two read only calls to Socialync: the list of profiles, then the numbers for each.

## Send the digest
One Slack message for all brands.

## Slack channel
Replace the Slack channel ID in Settings before you run anything.
